nativeRegression.coverageMethod: Unique test-case reconciliation across retained core and repaired/batched XCTest results, including eight Swift Testing tests. Initial failures retained in original result bundle; repaired classes supersede their previous results. Historical compiler variants are explicit negative controls.

semanticCompatibility.method: Exact re-export from the same pinned Rust revision; packaging identity only; original build receipt unchanged

additionalCompilerGroupFailure.reason: The default syn declaration was no longer blocked because the signed profile supports procedural macros. Only its stale blocked-package assertion failed; parser compilation succeeded. The updated test asserts the default proc-macro feature is really selected and checks blocking according to the signed capability, retaining the explicit parser-only run. The case was rerun after rebuilding the host.

repairsDuringRegression.explanation: The original manually signed Simulator host lacked Xcode simulated entitlements, causing two Keychain tests to fail. Rebuilding with Xcode Simulator signing fixed both without changing application entitlements. The syn authoring expectation now follows the signed macro capability. Six semantic tests exposed an old packaging identity; exact source re-export and signed-toolchain qualification preserve all 1,011 original source files and the unchanged analyzer engine. All affected classes were rerun. Eight Swift Testing cases omitted by Xcode OnlyTestIdentifiers were explicitly executed and reconciled. Original failed bundles remain retained.

historicalCompilerControls.purpose: Require the unchanged atomic canary to pass with the shipping compiler and reproduce its precise former failure with each immutable old compiler plus the original historical sysroot. These old variants remain defective and do not ship. Their renamed tests are negative controls, not claims that their binaries were fixed.

limits: Release-mode arm64 iOS 26.5 Simulator on Xcode/SDK 27.2; no physical-device performance claim.
Native AOT compiler experiment remains disabled.
Legacy migration fixtures are enabled explicitly for XCTest only and omitted from distribution archives.
